description: Create a new ad squad from a few choices (a web squad with a max bid, optimized for purchases by default; goal can be another pixel goal, traffic, awareness or video views). Always PAUSED. daily_budget and bid must be within the configured limits (SNAP_MIN_DAILY_BUDGET, SNAP_MAX_DAILY_BUDGET, SNAP_MAX_BID). Previews unless confirm=true. Pixel defaults to SNAP_PIXEL_ID. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token. Use after snap_create_campaign to set budget, goal, targeting and schedule. Not for changing an existing ad squad (use the matching set tool, such as snap_set_daily_budget or snap_set_targeting).

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

audience_days.description: Catalog ads: how many days of product activity count

bid.description: Max bid in account currency (required unless bid_strategy is AUTO_BID)

bid_strategy.description: How Snap bids: AUTO_BID, LOWEST_COST_WITH_MAX_BID or TARGET_COST.

campaign_id.description: Campaign id. Get it from snap_list_campaigns.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

conversion_window.description: How long after a swipe or view a purchase still counts, for example SWIPE_28DAY_VIEW_1DAY.

dpa_mode.description: Catalog ads: retargeting = people who viewed or added to cart but did not buy; prospecting = people who have not interacted with these products. Needs product_set_id.

gender.description: MALE, FEMALE or leave empty for everyone.

goal.description: What to optimize for. PIXEL_* goals (purchase, add to cart, page view, sign-up) need a pixel; SWIPES (traffic), IMPRESSIONS (awareness) and VIDEO_VIEWS goals do not. Web (link) ads only.

include_segment_ids.description: Ids of audiences to target. Get them from snap_list_segments.

max_age.description: Oldest age, up to 50 (50 means 50 and over).

name.description: Name to give the new item. Shown in Ads Manager.

os_type.description: iOS or ANDROID, or leave empty for both.

pixel_id.description: Snap Pixel id. Optional: defaults to SNAP_PIXEL_ID. Get it from snap_list_pixels.

product_set_id.description: Catalog ads: the product set this ad squad shows. The campaign must be a catalog campaign (snap_create_campaign with catalog_id) whose catalog holds this set.

name: snap_create_adsquad
